iLock_Geography
Package iLock_Geography :: Package predicate_library :: Module relation
[frames] | no frames]

Module relation

The module defines predicate classes representing releations in the mathematical sense.

Classes
  Equal
Predicate class that builds true point '(obj, obj)' for each obj in the domain of ALL_TYPE_C.
  Constant
Predicate class that builds true point '(obj)' for each obj of type ALL_TYPE_C if the argument const is True.
  Transitive
Predicate class that converts the given predicate to its transitive closure in terms of two specified components (of the same base type) in the signature of the predicate.
  Union
Predicate class that build a true point set which is the union of the true point sets of the given predicates.
  Singleton
  Reflexive
  Symmetric
  OrdinalSuccessor
